problem: Repeated local progress can expose a new residual family, creating an endless whack-a-mole loop. TRUMP therefore requires cumulative inheritance: every defeated route must leave a machine-checkable obstruction lesson that all successors must preserve unless a stronger theorem explicitly subsumes it.

watchbird_translation.learn: distill the exact failed premise, structural witness, and cost witness
watchbird_translation.fleet_update: every new universal candidate must replay all inherited lessons before promotion

frozen_lessons.lesson: Pure polynomially bounded resolution plus only resolution-tractable terminals cannot be universal for all 3CNF.
frozen_lessons.successor_obligation: Do not silently return to pure-resolution universality.

frozen_lessons.lesson: A fixed small tractable switchboard misses explicit 3CNF residuals.
frozen_lessons.successor_obligation: Finite portfolio coverage is never universal coverage without theorem.

frozen_lessons.lesson: Every fixed backdoor radius misses a scalable family.
frozen_lessons.successor_obligation: Do not promote fixed-k backdoor search to universal authority.

frozen_lessons.lesson: Universal context-independent assignment quotienting across a width-w boundary requires 2^w states.
frozen_lessons.successor_obligation: Any compression must exploit additional structure or a different representation.

frozen_lessons.lesson: The frozen compact signature classes do not cover NAE3.
frozen_lessons.successor_obligation: Do not equate Horn/dual-Horn/bijunctive/affine coverage with universal relation coverage.

candidate_universal_solver_must: show exact handling or explicit principled bypass for each lesson
charge discovery, compilation, state, and verification costs
promotion_gate.never: silently discard old counterexamples because a new route exists

anti_whack_a_mole_rule: A new problem is not treated as a reset. It is appended to the cumulative obligation set. Progress means the admissible future hypothesis space strictly shrinks while theorem authority stays unchanged until the universal bridge is discharged.
target_effect: Convert repeated counterexamples from an endless sequence of resets into monotone elimination of already-falsified proof architectures.
